discovery_notes: 44 WebSearch calls (search budget exhausted on the 45th). All claims from search snippets; no page reads. Main publishers Mousesteps (pre-release monthly schedules, so dates/sizes are planned not confirmed), Disney Pins Blog, Laughing Place, DLP Report (X), Medium preview sheets, MyPinCentral (pin database, used for 2 listings). Marketplace/reseller hits (eBay, Mercari, Whatnot, Madhouse Collectibles) ignored; they claimed: Aristocats Pin Trading Day 2024 LE 500, Tink/Periwinkle jumbo LE 500, Gaston LE 425, Alice event Dodo LE 425, Pride spinning Mickey jumbo LE 500, St Patrick 101 Dalmatians LE 700 - all unverified. Date conflict: Feb PTT Feb 23 (DPB) vs Feb 28 (DLP Report). DLP Report (Mar 2024) noted pin price raise: green EUR 8->9, yellow 11->12, pink 13->15. Gaps: January and May schedules, October dates, December LE detail, PTT surprise pins for Mar/Jun/Sep/Oct/Nov, Be Our Guest event pins. No suspicious/instructional content seen.
